svg.text: Phase 2 — configuration, transport, the store, the risk seam
Task groups 2.2 to 2.5, all inside ADA_ECU/src/. One box per subtask; every arrow is a stated dependency.
Groups 2.2, 2.3, 2.4 — the foundation, the two parsers, the store and its admission rules
the only place environment is read
the only holder of a socket
one JSON line per event
two writers, one reader
the admission rules, as pure logic
the store of tracked vehicles
relayed message to a store record
detector line to a store record
admission and expiry, in the store
the malformed-input corpus
to the composition root
and the loopback check
(next diagram)
Group 2.5 — the risk-assessment seam: its record format, its interface, its store, its registry
the assessment record format
the interface, frozen
the store of assessment records
the registry a plugin joins
The two parsers matter because they end in the same call: one store, one way in, whether a vehicle
was seen by ego's own camera or reported over the radio link. That identity is the phase's first
acceptance box, and it is why the malformed-input corpus is tested against both parsers at once.
closed
delivered by a later diagram
